_why: THE CENSUS, NOT AN EXCUSE. Every entry is a client write the authenticated role genuinely cannot perform — it fails at run time with 42501, in the console. They were found by this checker on the day it was written (2026-09-18) and belong to lanes other than the one that wrote the guard, so they are recorded rather than silently fixed or silently ignored. This list ONLY SHRINKS: an entry that is no longer an offender fails the check too, so a fix cannot leave a stale excuse behind, and anything NEW is a hard failure with no entry available.
_how_to_clear_one: Almost never by granting the client the privilege. A table the client may not write is a table the SERVER writes: move the call behind an aidream endpoint, the way /acquisition/blocks did in 2026-09-18's fix. Then delete the entry.

offenders.note: The doors-only closure on schema platform withdrew UPDATE on platform.associations from authenticated; this remediation write has answered 42501 ever since. Owner: the surfaces/manifest-sync lane. The fix is the same one FIX-10A-ASSISTS used for platform.assists: a SECURITY DEFINER door registered in platform.client_callable_door, never a new grant.

_corrected_2026-09-22: FIX-10A-ASSISTS removed two entries that were never real writes. The chain pattern used to walk across statement boundaries, so it read `.schema("seo")` from one statement, `.from("page")` from another and `.update(` from a third: features/marketing/search-console/data-launch.ts writes seo.page through authenticatedWebDb() with no .schema() in the chain at all, and features/tool-registry/lookups/services/lookups.service.ts has no tool.ui_surface upsert anywhere in it. Both names were invented by the gap. The gaps now stop at `;`. A write that carries no explicit .schema() is outside what this guard measures - that is a separate finding, not this one.
